titulo: What If Bob Got All the Money in the World?  #whatif #animation #science
descripcion:
What if every dollar on Earth suddenly landed in Bob's bank account? 💰📱

Bob wakes up with ALL the money in the world (cash + bank deposits, roughly $100 trillion — an estimate). Sounds like the dream… until he tries to buy a simple coffee ☕❌

Here's the catch: if nobody else has a single dollar, nobody can pay for fuel, wages or deliveries. Farms, trucks and cafés still exist — but nothing moves. 🚚🌱🏪

Money only works when it moves. So what does Bob do? 🤔

⚠️ Simplified "what if" model for fun — real economies have credit, banks and governments that would react too.

💬 Who should Bob pay first: the farmer, the driver or the barista? Tell me in the comments! 👇
